Reach

Reach you can’t plan around

All 7 of your recent reels cleared 2k views, from only 81 posts. People clearly want what you teach. But without ads, who sees your next post depends on the algorithm that week, not on you.

Launches

Events that start and stop

Workshops and retreats are where people feel your work. They also only fill when you push them. Between launches, a parent who finds you today has no small step I could find that is open right now.

Qualifying

Interest you can’t see

Someone can listen to your podcast for months and you’d never know they’re ready for 1:1. Without a class and an application, the ready parents look exactly like the curious ones.

Your bio already speaks to parents who want to stop reacting and start leading from calm. From the outside, I couldn’t find an open door where they can learn from you this week and raise their hand.

My recommendation

A $17 live class, “From Reacting to Responding”, running every week on ads

A paid class earns from the first sale and pays for the ads. The Conscious Pause Toolkit on the thank-you page adds to it, and an application on the replay page sends the ready parents to 1:1 coaching with you. Your workshops and retreat stay exactly as they are, and become the next step for parents who loved the class but aren’t ready for 1:1.

Parenting Coach

Sound familiar?

You know the parent you want to be. Then the moment comes.

  • You’ve read the books and saved the posts, and in the moment it all still disappears.
  • You promise yourself you’ll stay calm, then hear your own parents’ words come out of your mouth.
  • You end the day replaying what you said and wishing you’d paused first.
  • You want a home that feels connected, without having to be a perfect parent to get there.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover live

Why we react

What is really happening inside you in the heated moment, explained in plain words, without blame.

The patterns we inherit

How the way we were parented shows up in how we parent, and how to start choosing differently.

The pause

A simple notice, breathe, respond practice you can use in the middle of a busy evening.

Repair after a hard moment

What to say after you’ve lost your cool, so connection comes back instead of guilt.

Connection over control

Small daily shifts that make home feel calmer for everyone, starting with you.

Meet Milica

Hi, I’m Milica

I’m a conscious living and parenting coach based in Chicago. I trained and certified in Dr Shefali’s conscious parenting coach programme, and I hold a Compassionate Inquiry coach certification.

Through Parenting Metamorphosis, my workshops, retreat and podcast, I help parents shift from reacting to responding, so home can feel more connected for everyone.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Why is it $17 and not free?

Because parents who invest, even a little, show up and actually practise what they learn. I want a room full of people ready to try something new.

Is this therapy?

No. This is coaching and education, not therapy. It doesn’t replace a therapist, doctor or care team. For anything clinical, please speak with your own provider.

Do I need to have read anything first?

No. Whether conscious parenting is new to you or you’ve been reading about it for years, the class is built around practical tools you can use straight away.

What if I can’t make it live?

Save your seat anyway. Every seat includes the full replay.

Will you talk about coaching at the end?

For the last few minutes I’ll share how to apply to work with me 1:1, for anyone who wants to go further. Everything before that is yours to use either way.

Script 1 · “The pause”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The most powerful parenting tool takes about five seconds.”

Body

“It’s the pause. Notice what’s rising in you. Breathe. Then respond. It sounds simple, and in the heat of the moment it’s the hardest thing in the world. The good news: it’s a skill, and skills can be practised.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in From Reacting to Responding. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera against a white backdrop in your red top, captions on, end card “Coaching, not therapy”. No “you” statements about the viewer’s feelings in captions.

Script 2 · “It starts with us”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Conscious parenting isn’t about the perfect words. It starts with us.”

Body

“So many of the reactions we have at home were learned long before we became parents. When we see those patterns clearly, we get to choose something different. That’s where calm really comes from.”

CTA

“Join my live class for $17, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: slow walk or seated by a window, on-screen text “Notice · Breathe · Respond”. Warm, reflective tone, captions on.

Script 3 · “Repair”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Every parent loses their cool sometimes. Here’s what matters more.”

Body

“Every parent has hard moments. What builds connection is what happens next: coming back, owning your part, and reconnecting. In my class I share the simple repair steps I teach parents.”

CTA

“From Reacting to Responding, live, $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: quick cuts with on-screen cards: Come back · Own your part · Reconnect. Keep the focus on you, no family footage.
